full_name: Pumla Gobodo-Madikizela | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2020–2021 Humanities Walter Jackson Bate Fellow Stellenbosch University (South Africa)
bio: At Radcliffe, Pumla Gobodo-Madikizela returns to the archive of the Truth and Reconciliation Commission to think through the horrific violence in contemporary South Africa.
